'''Leona Makk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who [[Captain/Legends|captained]] the [[Brayl-class bulk freighter|bulk hauler]] ''[[Voxen Tass]]'' for [[Shang Lines]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was a supporter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and used her position at Shang Lines to supply the Rebels with information on local shipping.

During the [[Blockade of the Endocray sector]], Makk was critical in delivering an Alliance strike team to [[Argovia]], where they [[Mission to Argovia|destroyed]] a [[Imperial Sensor Net Complex|sensor net]] established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
